Lemma
[Tensoriality of the second covariant derivative]

↗ def:second-covariant-derivative-vector-field

For fixed $Z$, the map $(X,Y)\mapsto abla ^2Z(X,Y)$ is additive in each argument and satisfies \[ abla ^2Z(\varphi X,Y)=\varphi abla ^2Z(X,Y) = abla ^2Z(X,\varphi Y) \] for every smooth $\varphi $. Hence its value at $p$ depends on $X,Y$ only through $X(p),Y(p)$.

Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:levi-civita-connection

Additivity follows from additivity of the connection. Scaling the first direction is immediate from linearity in the direction slot. Scaling the second direction produces the same Leibniz cross term in both terms defining the second covariant derivative, so those terms cancel. The resulting smooth-function bilinearity proves pointwise dependence.

□
